column1: # CADCraft Turkish interface catalog — original translations by the CADCraft contributors.
# License: MIT OR Apache-2.0 (the repository LICENSE-MIT and LICENSE-APACHE).
# Written from CADCraft's English strings; no proprietary translations were copied.
# Clean room: every entry is written from the plain meaning of the English label in ordinary
# Turkish computing and technical-drawing vocabulary (Katman, Ölçülendirme, Tarama, Yuvarlatma,
# Pah, Öteleme, Kırp, Uzat, Nesne Kenetleme, Görünüm Penceresi, Yerleşim). No other product's
# Turkish interface, string table or terminology database was consulted, and no other catalog is
# used as a source.
# UTF-8: context<TAB>English source<TAB>Turkish translation.
# Empty context = ordinary label; @plural = one form with {n} (a Turkish noun stays singular after
# a number: "3 commit", "5 katkıda bulunan"); menu = a menu heading where it differs from the label.
# Prompts use "… girin" for Enter and "… belirtin" for Specify. Suffixes are never attached to a
# {placeholder}, since they follow the vowels of the word before them.
# Keep command IDs, keywords (Top, Zero, Bottom, _tan to, nX/nXP, Multiple, PICKADD, QPMODE),
# technology/product names and user data unchanged.
